title.en: How much return would cover this cost?
title.zh: 需要多少收益才能覆盖这项成本？

scope.en: Illustrative arithmetic scenario. Controls use hypothetical inputs, not BMLL observations or measured portfolio costs.
scope.zh: 算术情景演示。滑块使用假设输入，未引用 BMLL 观测或实测组合成本。

formula.en: Annual hurdle = full spread ÷ 10,000 × 252 ÷ holding days × replacement fraction. One basis point is 0.01%.
formula.zh: 年度成本门槛＝完整价差÷10,000×252÷持有天数×替换比例。1个基点为0.01%。

limits.en: Assumes one full spread per complete buy-and-sell cycle. Impact, fees, signal returns and price drift are absent. Values above 100% describe an expensive scenario, not a loss probability. Actual trades may occur inside the quote or cost more.
limits.zh: 假设每轮完整买卖承担一个完整价差。未计入冲击、费用、信号收益和价格漂移。超过100%的值表示该情景成本很高，不能解释为损失概率。实际成交可能发生在价差内，也可能付出更高成本。

static.en: The static table uses a 50-basis-point spread and 100% replacement. Enable JavaScript to change the inputs.
static.zh: 静态表格采用50基点价差和100%替换比例。启用 JavaScript 后可以调整输入。
